assembly.title: Solve an equation
assembly.learningGoal: Solve a linear equation ax + b = c with exact rational, equivalence-preserving subtraction and division, signed symbolic tokens and step history.

assembly.title: Explore line slope
assembly.learningGoal: Independent bounded linear function y=mx+b with an authoritative point dataset and rise/run marker; multiple instances compare lines.

assembly.title: Why π stays constant
assembly.learningGoal: Circle geometry with positive radius, calculated diameter and circumference, an unrolling illustration and invariant C/d ratio.

assembly.title: Diluting salt water
assembly.learningGoal: Salt-water dilution in a beaker. Adding water keeps the dissolved salt mass constant, increases solution volume, and lowers salt concentration. Compare independent beakers.

assembly.title: Balancing chemical equations
assembly.learningGoal: Conservation of atoms in chemical reactions: editable coefficients and molecule pictures show why a chemical equation needs balancing. Count each element on both sides. Registered water and carbon-dioxide reactions only.

assembly.title: Temperature and reaction rate
assembly.learningGoal: Chemical reaction rate for A to B (A → B). Temperature in kelvin changes the first-order Arrhenius rate and half-life; observe reactant A and product B concentrations over time, conserving A+B. Compare independent reaction runs at different temperatures. Changing one run's temperature restarts that run at t=0.

assembly.title: Dye diffusion in water
assembly.learningGoal: A central dye deposit spreads through a bounded square concentration field under Fickian diffusion. Compare coefficients at equal simulation times.

assembly.title: Fox and rabbit populations
assembly.learningGoal: A Lotka–Volterra continuous population model for rabbits and foxes, integrated with fixed-step fourth-order Runge–Kutta. Compare initial rabbit populations while preserving all rates.

assembly.title: Plant limiting resources
assembly.learningGoal: A bounded educational resource-response model where the least available normalized resource limits linear illustrative biomass growth.

assembly.title: Compound and simple interest
assembly.learningGoal: Compare annual compound growth P(1+r)^t with simple interest P(1+rt) for a starting balance, annual rate, and whole-year duration. Use $100, 5%, and 10 years when the learner does not specify values.

assembly.title: Stop-and-go traffic on a closed road
assembly.learningGoal: Seeded vehicles follow the Intelligent Driver Model on a periodic closed road. A brief brake disturbance changes authoritative vehicle speeds and can grow into a backward-travelling slow region without an accident. Compare a lower-density independent ring when requested.

assembly.title: One or two checkout cashiers
assembly.learningGoal: A seeded FIFO checkout scheduler compares one or two cashiers over a fixed horizon. Changing cashier count reuses exactly the same pre-generated customer arrival times and service durations.
